notes: «أنه سمع عروة، يقول» : Urwa is named as the one heard («سمع X» is a link, rule 5); occurrence 2 because «يحيى بن عروة» contains the word first
«قالت عائشة» : Aisha is the Companion whose words relay the saying, the last link; the Companions in the story (who asked the Prophet) are scene only
